contexts: rapid response teams of nurse, respiratory therapist and physician
reading: The programme acts on teams (role clarity, speed), on wards (latent safety threats, ward nurse escalation) and indirectly on families. Real-call timing responds to training in the retrieved evidence while admissions do not, and simulation checklist scores are poor proxies for real performance. With four hospitals, clustering and calendar time dominate the analysis. The qualitative strand is needed to explain differences between hospitals that four clusters cannot estimate.
